title: Interview Notice for the posts of contractual teaching faculty (Assistant Professor and Tutor for Academic Arrangement 2026) for the Institute of Nursing and the Institute of Paramedical Sciences at the South Campus

FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
SOUTH CAMPUS
(NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”)
Highground, Fatehgarh Anantnag-192101 Jammu & Kashmir
..........
Interview Notice
Contractual Teaching faculty for Institute Of Nursing & Paramedical Sciences
It is hereby notified for the information of all applicants who have applied in response to
Advertisement Notice No. F (Advt-Appt-Cont-2026-NUR) DAA/KU-06 dated 15-01-2026 for
the posts of contractual teaching faculty (Assistant Professor and Tutor for Academic
Arrangement 2026) for the Institute of Nursing and the Institute of Paramedical Sciences at
the South Campus, that the updated status list of candidates, along with their merit scores,
is available on the South Campus website: https://southcampus.uok.edu.in.
Further, the interview of eligible candidates will be held in the office chamber of the Dean
Academic Affairs, University of Kashmir, Hazratbal, Srinagar as per the following schedule:
Name of the Programme Place of Interview Day & Date Time
B.Sc. Nursing Main Campus 10.04.2026(Friday) 10:00 a.m
B.Sc. M.L.T -do- 11.04.2026 (Saturday) 10:00 a.m
Note:-
 Candidates are advised to be present half an hour before the time of interview;
 Candidates are advised to bring all the Academic & Experience Certificates /
Testimonials in original & Ph.D. thesis / research publication (s) if any, on the
date of interview;
 No TA/ DA shall be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview and no
individual call letters will be sent.
Sd/-
Director
NO. F (Interview ION-PS – South Campus) SC/KU/26
Dated: - 3rd April, 2026
Website: southcampus.uok.edu.in Email: directorsouthcampus@uok.edu.in
